patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Motion and Wrike share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Motion and Wrike share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Motion only if your buying job matches “AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo an” rather than Wrike's shape. Choose Wrike only if your buying job matches “Enterprise/agency work management with proofing, intake and resourcing — Team from $10/use” rather than Motion's shape. Workflow advantage: Motion leans shared coverage; Wrike leans resource-planning, team-collaboration-work. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Motion and Wrike share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Motion is AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo annual.; Wrike is Enterprise/agency work management with proofing, intake and resourcing — Team from $10/user/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Motion (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Wrike (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Motion-leaning — vs Wrike-leaning resource-planning, team-collaboration-work.
- Researched limits: Motion — Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors; Wrike — Business tier pricing jump.

Limitations — Motion: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors; AI credit caps and top-ups affect TCO; Wrike: Business tier pricing jump; Heavier admin than lightweight tools.

Poor-fit cases: Motion is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors · Wrike is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Business tier pricing jump · Avoid Motion if you actually need Wrike's motion (Enterprise/agency work management with proofing, intake and resourcing — Team fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
